item.title: Brown University Hires Chief Wiggum To Track Down Shooter
item.description: PROVIDENCE, RI — Leadership at Brown University, frustrated with the lack of progress in tracking the shooter who killed two students and injured many more on December 13, has reportedly recruited Police Chief Clancy Wiggum of Springfield to assist in the case.

item.title: Trump Imposes 25% Tariffs On All Incoming Christmas Presents From The North Pole
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — Families hoping for financial relief for the holiday season received troubling news today, as President Donald Trump announced he was imposing 25% tariffs on all incoming Christmas presents from the North Pole.

item.title: Santa Hat Added To Halloween Decoration
item.description: DAYTON, OH — A giant skeleton Halloween decoration received an updated look this week as its owners climbed a ladder and placed a Santa hat on its head, thus brilliantly transforming it into a Christmas decoration.

item.title: Introvert Samaritan Crosses To Other Side Of Street To Avoid Small Talk With Man Left For Dead
item.description: JERICHO — The victim of a local violent assault and robbery saw his predicament go from bad to worse today, as an introverted Samaritan reportedly crossed over to the other side of the road to avoid having to make small talk with a man who had been beaten and left for dead.

item.title: Authorities Warn Libs Now Dangerously Mad
item.description: U.S. — Federal authorities announced on Wednesday that liberals are now dangerously mad, a significant update from when they were just regular mad only days ago.

item.title: 9 Booby Traps That Were Cut From 'Home Alone'
item.description: The holiday classic Home Alone featured some of the most iconic improvised booby traps in movie history, but did you know that the original script included many more of them?

item.title: Everyone In Michigan Arrested Just To Be Safe
item.description: ANN ARBOR, MI — In the wake of police arresting University of Michigan's football coach Sherrone Moore, authorities have decided to go ahead and just arrest everyone else in Michigan, just to be safe.
